research_window.note: Continuous research coverage begins at the prior release's preserved UTC boundary and ends at this run's evidence cutoff.

dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

The August employment release is an independently measured economic outcome. Trump's subsequent trade threat used the report as context but is a distinct presidential risk statement with no implementing instrument; neither record substitutes for the other.

The September 4 orders direct ranching, competition, processing, wolf and labeling actions. The August 26 proclamation separately implemented a temporary lean-beef import quota increase; the instruments and outcome tests are distinct.

The national measles surveillance outcome concerns a vaccine-preventable infectious disease. The August 31 newborn record measures vitamin K nonreceipt, which is not a vaccine and involves a different intervention, population and outcome.

LEG-004706 records the June 22 district-court summary judgment vacating modified SAVE. The new record covers the September 4 appellate refusal to stay that judgment and the expedited merits appeal; both stages remain cross-referenced under the same litigation.

The Central African Republic record covers a second implemented flight to that country. The Guyana record covers the first implemented group under a separate bilateral arrangement, different people and different post-transfer terms.

The Liberia record documents a separate agreement and capacity announcement. The Guyana record documents actual arrival of a different six-person group under a one-year temporary arrangement; neither is a duplicate of the other.

The September 4 record concerns a conditional threat to restrict trade with unspecified deficit countries if the Federal Reserve did not cut rates. The September 7 Bombardier statement names one company, ties U.S. market access to domestic manufacturing and arises in a separate Canada aviation dispute; neither threat had an implementing instrument by its cutoff.
The new record documents a named GSA procurement direction, not another tariff implementation. Tariffs, Bombardier sales threats and schedule eligibility have distinct instruments and consequences.

The September 8 appellate ruling in No. 26-5006 is distinct from the April 2025 DOGE-management account. The latter remains unreviewed and queued for source repair; it is not counted as the same court event.

rejected_candidates.title: Seventeen new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: Eight text-bearing posts and one accessible image were inspected; they contained campaign promotion, personal commentary, praise, criticism, memorial commentary or reposts without a new federal implementing action. Eleven media assets returned HTTP 403 and remain explicitly unavailable for review; no claim inside them was used. The feed rose from 36,187 to 36,204 posts; newest September 8 at 10:25:12 PM EDT, checked at 11:59:43 PM EDT.

rejected_candidates.title: Prior-window Iran tanker-strike omission
rejected_candidates.reason: CENTCOM and independent coverage of five September 8 tanker strikes were published before the prior 22:02:19Z boundary but were not available in the prior release review. The omission is restored transparently under the actual September 8 event date and is not misdated as a new action.

rejected_candidates.title: Late-posted Canadian import proclamations
rejected_candidates.reason: Five signed September 8 proclamations were available on official White House pages and independently described by the Associated Press before cutoff. The archive preserves their September 15 and 29 future effective dates and does not describe scheduled exclusions as already implemented.

rejected_candidates.title: USPS inspector-general review and ABA diversity-standard repeal
rejected_candidates.reason: Both remain material leads. The complete primary scope of the OIG review and the adopted ABA council text were not located and inspected; no investigation finding or federal recognition revocation is inferred.

rejected_candidates.title: Fox–Roku antitrust inquiry and Florida grand-jury subpoenas
rejected_candidates.reason: The Fox–Roku report depended on unnamed sources and Reuters said it could not independently verify it. The Florida report lacked a public subpoena, court docket or second independent account by cutoff. Both remain queued without converting reported process into a finding.

rejected_candidates.title: FDA appointments and other routine or duplicate developments
rejected_candidates.reason: Four permanent FDA appointments were routine personnel stabilization without a separate policy implementation. Repeated Canada, Iran, Ukraine, mail-ballot and campaign coverage added no distinct lifecycle event beyond the records refreshed here.

rejected_candidates.title: Legacy-quality batch
rejected_candidates.reason: No material historical correction passed review. LEG-003957 retains its stable ID and honest unreviewed state because its stored citation does not support the entry and a directly inspected replacement could not be completed; the discrepancy remains visible in the durable queue.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive measurements
rejected_candidates.reason: All four registered project pages were checked. Trump Archive advanced to 13,915 items, including 11,533 Truth Social posts; UndoTrump remained 1,264 actions and IPTP remained 1,790 policy actions. Record47 API endpoints could not be freshly verified, so its prior measurements and observation times were preserved. No external lead was promoted by count alone.
